chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, who said:
I said to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام: May I be made your ransom, is the tashahhud that is in the second [rakʿah] sufficient for me to say in the fourth? He said: Yes.

key_terms.التَّشَهُّدُ: the testimony recited in salat (prayer) while sitting
key_terms.الثَّانِيَةِ: the second rakʿah of the prayer
key_terms.الرَّابِعَةِ: the fourth rakʿah of the prayer
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative response establishing the ruling
key_terms.يُجْزِي: is sufficient and fulfills the required minimum

ai.seo_question: Is the tashahhud of the second rakʿah sufficient to recite in the fourth rakʿah of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the tashahhud in salat (prayer). It indicates that the same tashahhud recited in the second rakʿah is sufficient to be recited in the fourth rakʿah as well.
